title: Rebecca B FDE 6049 NDE 6049
content: My father had passed away almost one year at the time of my car accident. I was making a surprise visit to my mother. I lost control of my car in some rock matter on the side of the road at a high rate of speed. I was headed in a head on collision situation towards a mother and her daughter after I had lost control of the car. There was no response from the other driver, so I swerved to miss her and her daughter whom I can see very clearly until this day. When I did swerve, I overcompensated with the steering wheel, did a 180-degree spin in the road, and hit a ditch. The car began to roll end over end six times. As I was rolling over and over, I thought to myself, 'Is this how it ends? Is this it; you mean the end? This is the way I go? It is all over like this? Wow, I'm okay with me then, if this is it!' I remember feeling so at peace as things were obviously hitting me in the head which I do not remember anything touching me. I remember opening my eyes and looking at the side airbags deploy and I closed my eyes again. I felt an overwhelming calmness in my life that I have never felt and don't know that I would ever feel as long as I am here on this earth. A certain stillness and comfort like no other. Then all of a sudden, the car lands on all four wheels. I opened the door a little shaken and walked away from the car with minor glass infractions in my hand and a few bumps on the back of my head after being hit by objects in the car. A man walked up to me and handed me a business card that read 'Heavens Gait', which is a horse ranch outside of Abilene, Texas, exactly 30 miles from my destination. After receiving the card I looked up and the man was gone across an open field. I have tried calling the phone number and there is no answer. This was an eye opening experience in the aspect that the next day I woke up and I had to ask myself, 'Why am I here? What is my purpose?' I told myself that it is probably not for me to know what my purpose is here on earth, just keep living it and I have done just that! There are times that I, all of a sudden, after a crisis of sorts helped myself or others and told myself, 'This is my purpose'.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Predominant element was an overwhelming calm/peace during the car rollover; afterward an anomalous encounter with a man who handed a business card reading 'Heavens Gait' and then was gone.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: After the crash, a man approached and handed her a business card that read 'Heavens Gait' (a horse ranch outside Abilene, Texas, 30 miles from her destination). After she looked up, the man was gone across an open field; calling the number later yielded no answer.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Is this how it ends? Is this it; you mean the end? This is the way I go? It is all over like this? Wow, I'm okay with me then, if this is it!' ; 'Why am I here? What is my purpose?'
